{{Quote|To walk the path of the Jedi, one's spirit must be strong. That requires discipline.|Oppo Rancisis|<ref name="Ultimate SW" />}}
'''Oppo Rancisis''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Thisspiasian]] [[Gender|male]] [[Jedi Master]] who served on the [[Jedi High Council|Jedi Council]] during the [[High Republic Era]], [[Invasion of Naboo]], and the [[Clone Wars]]. He was known to be one of the wisest members of the Council, respected for his quiet wisdom and devotion to [[the Force]]. Rancisis was a survivor of the initial [[Great Jedi Purge]].

==Biography==
===Jedi career===
{{Quote|But we have been a military force in the past. In fact, our predecessors waged and won the Great Sith War.|Oppo Rancisis, to the Jedi Council|<ref name="LOTJ">''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]''</ref>}}
Oppo Rancisis was [[Reproduction|born]] on the rocky temperate [[Planet|world]] of [[Thisspias]]<ref name="UP" /> to royal [[parent]]s<ref name="Join the Battle" /> and was the heir to the [[Thisspiasian]] [[Blood Monarchy]].<ref name="UP" /> Although he was of royal heritage,<ref name="Force Collection">{{ForceCollection|Oppo Rancisis|star=3}}</ref> Rancisis joined the [[Jedi Order]] as a [[youngling]] while still an infant.<ref name="Join the Battle" /> He became the [[Padawan]] [[Jedi training|learner]] of [[Jedi Master]] [[Yaddle]].<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> At some point, Rancisis was offered the throne of the [[Blood Monarch]],<ref name="UP" /> but he declined and chose to continue a life of service as a [[Jedi]] instead.<ref name="Join the Battle" />

===High Republic Era===
During the High Republic Era, Oppo Rancisis oversaw the construction of a [[Jedi temple]] on [[Falaston]].<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars: The High Republic: Chronicles of the Jedi]]''</ref> He and his Padawan [[Dal Azim]] saved a group of [[Slavery|slaves]] from an [[Attack on the Zygerrian camp|attack]] on a [[Zygerrian]] [[Unidentified Zygerrian camp|encampment]], including the [[Twi'lek]] [[Lourna Dee]]. Rancisis became fond of Dee after seeing her willingness to put her life on the line for the other captives, and suggested that she enroll in the [[Carida Academy|Carida Military Academy]] in order to gain skills that would help those in need. Dee reluctantly agreed. Rancisis checked in on Dee and her progress at the academy from time to time, but the two eventually lost touch when Dee abandoned the Academy.<ref name="Tempest Runner" />

By the year [[232 BBY]],<ref name="Date note">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]'' to [[232 BBY]].</ref> Rancisis had become a member of the [[Jedi High Council]], the governing body of the Order,<ref name="LOTJ" /> and went onto be one of its oldest members.<ref name="Join the Battle" />

In the aftermath of the [[Great Hyperspace Disaster]] and the [[Emergences]], the Supreme Chancellor of the Republic, [[Lina Soh]], requested that the Jedi participate in a mission to hunt down or eradicate the raiders called the [[Nihil]], who had caused the disaster and the Emergences. The Jedi Council called a meeting to discuss participating in such action, which Rancisis was present for, joining as a [[hologram]]. During the meeting Master [[Adampo]] insisted that they should not join the mission, because it was a military action and the Jedi were not a military force. Rancisis responded to this by saying that the Jedi had acted as a military force in the past, in conflicts such as the [[Great Sith War]], which Master [[Rana Kant]] responded to by stating that they were not currently at war. Ultimately, the deciding vote was taken by Master [[Jora Malli]], who voted in favor of providing Jedi support in attempting to destroy the Nihil during the [[Battle of Kur]].<ref name="LOTJ" />

====Attack on Tanalorr====
{{Quote|Fall back to the temple! The Nihil are enveloping our position! Master Gera, that is an order!|Oppo Rancisis|<ref name="Survivor">''[[Star Wars Jedi: Survivor]]''</ref>}}
That same year,<ref name="TanalorrDate">The attack on [[Tanalorr]] takes place after the [[Great Hyperspace Disaster]], which {{SW|url=news/swce-2023-lucasfilm-publishing-panel|text=SWCE 2023: 10 Reveals from the Lucasfilm Publishing Panel}} establishes was the first conflict between the [[Jedi Order]] and the [[Nihil]], and before the end of the [[Emergences]], which ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic: Chronicles of the Jedi]]'' establishes ended before the [[dedication of the Starlight Beacon]]. As ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates both the Great [[Hyperspace]] Disaster and the dedication of the [[Starlight Beacon]] to [[232 BBY]], the attack on [[Tanalorr]] must take place within that year.</ref> Rancicis went to [[Tanalorr]] to see if the planet was suitable for the Jedi to establish a strong presence on the world, but his visit was cut short by an [[Attack on Tanalorr|attack]] by the Nihil. During the battle, the Nihil began to surround the Jedi's position and Rancisis ordered the Jedi to fall back to the [[Jedi temple (Tanalorr)|Jedi Temple]] that had been built. The Nihil's strong attack and the difficulty of reaching the planet due to the [[Koboh Abyss]] nebula made the Jedi Council decide to abandon Tanalorr altogether.<ref name="Survivor" />

===Naboo Crisis===
[[File:High_Council_Chamber.png|thumb|left|330px|Oppo in the [[Jedi Council Chamber|High Council Chamber]] with other Jedi members testing Anakin Skywalker]]
Shortly before the [[Battle of Naboo]], Rancisis, still a member of the Council, was present in the [[Jedi Council Chamber|Council Chamber]] of the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]] when Jedi Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] came before the Council with news that the [[Sith]], the ancient enemies of the Jedi Order, had resurfaced. He later observed Jedi Master [[Mace Windu]] evaluate the [[The Force|Force]] abilities of [[Anakin Skywalker]], a nine-year-old boy from the planet [[Tatooine]] whom Jinn had discovered to be [[Force-sensitive]] and believed to be the [[Chosen One]], a being who was prophesied to bring balance to the Force. Although the child was strong in the Force, the Council denied Skywalker entrance into the Order as they found his deep emotional attachments troubling and believed that he was too old for training.<ref name="The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref> Rancisis saw a threat to the Order in the form of Skywalker.<ref name="Force Collection" /> The Council reversed their decision, however, after Jinn was [[Death|slain]] by the [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul|Darth Maul]] on [[Naboo]], allowing Skywalker to become the [[Padawan]] of Jinn's former apprentice [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], per Jinn's dying wish.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

===Separatist Crisis===
[[File:Jedicouncil2.jpg|thumb|right|330px|Oppo in the High Council Chamber as the council are briefed by Obi-Wan Kenobi]]
Rancisis still served on the Council ten years after the invasion of Naboo. During this time thousands of star systems joined a [[Separatist Crisis|secessionist movement]] who wanted independence from the [[Galactic Republic]]. The council feared that if a pan-[[The galaxy|galactic]] war were to break out they wouldn't have enough manpower to defend the Republic from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] threat. Around this time the life of [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] was threatened by an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|assassination attempt]], causing the Council to assign Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker as protection for the Senator. This eventually lead to Obi-Wan discovering that a [[Clone trooper|Clone army]] was being [[Cloning|manufactured]] in secret on the world of [[Kamino]] at the request of Jedi Master [[Sifo-Dyas]], who had perished some years prior. Rancisis was present on Coruscant when the Council was brought this news. Troubled by this information, the council sent Obi-Wan to [[Geonosis]] to track down the [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]], who was the man responsible for the attempts on Amidala's life as well as providing the genetic template for the clone Army. This request ultimately lead to the beginning of the pan-galactic conflict known as the [[Clone Wars]], as the [[Confederacy military|Separatist army]] and the new [[Grand Army of the Republic]] fought each other in what would become known as the [[First Battle of Geonosis|first battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref>

===Clone Wars===
With the Republic now at war, Rancisis was chosen by the Jedi Council to be its primary representative at [[Republic High Command]] meetings as a member of the organization.<ref name="Rise" /> Throughout the war, Rancisis remained a high ranking Jedi on the High Council, and a key military advisor, also serving as a Jedi general throughout the war, coordinating Republic forces across the galaxy.<ref name="USWNE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref>

====Mission to Hissrich====
[[File:OppoRancisis-TCWCEJtB.png|thumb|left|220px|Oppo remained on the Jedi Council during the Clone Wars.]]
Early in the war, Rancisis was present in a council meeting briefing Master Windu on a task they had for the esteemed master. Scouts had discovered that the Separatist Alliance had occupied the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] world of [[Hissrich]]. The council feared that the Confederacy were attempting to utilize the backwater planet as a staging ground to assault neighboring [[Star system|systems]]. In order to discern the threat level of the occupation the Council tasked Master Windu alongside Master [[Kit Fisto]], Master [[Tenth Brother|Dibs]] and [[Jedi Knight]] [[Rissa Mano|Mano]] to run a covert information seeking mission on the threat.<ref name="Mace Windu I">[[Jedi of the Republic – Mace Windu 1|''Jedi of the Republic – Mace Windu'' 1]]</ref>

In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TCWcanondates|608}}</ref> [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] informed the Jedi High Council of [[Queen]] [[Julia]] of [[Bardotta]]'s request for [[Jar Jar Binks]] to assist her after the disappearance of [[Dagoyan Order|Dagoyan Masters]]. Rancisis and the rest of the council discussed the matter and Mace Windu volunteered to accompany Binks.<ref name="The Disappeared, Part I">{{TCW|The Disappeared, Part I}}</ref>

====Reinvestigation of Sifo Dyas====
Later that year, Rancisis was present when [[Plo Koon]] revealed that he found the [[lightsaber]] of Sifo-Dyas. [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] confirmed that it was, and decided they needed to investigate. While on a [[Mission to Oba Diah (Clone Wars)|mission]] to uncover the [[Mission to Oba Diah (Sifo-Dyas)|death]] of Master Sifo-Dyas who ordered the creation of the [[Grand Army of the Republic|clone army]], Rancisis was present when Kenobi and Skywalker reported that [[Count]] [[Dooku]] was behind with the creation of the [[Clone trooper|clone]] [[army]]. The Council kept it a secret out of concern for how it could affect public support for the Republic.<ref name="The Lost One">{{TCW|The Lost One}}</ref>

====Voice from the dead====
[[File:MaceLuminaraObiWanOppo-Voices.png|thumb|right|330px|Oppo Rancisis confers with fellow Jedi in the Temple corridor.]]
Rancisis was later present when Yoda claimed to hear the voice of a long-dead Qui-Gon Jinn, who had mastered the ability to become a [[Force spirit]] after being killed by [[Maul|Darth Maul]]. Rancisis along with the other members of the Council participated in [[meditation]] in order to see if the Masters could sense Jinn's presence.

After this long meditation, Rancisis was slithering through the temple with his Jedi friends [[Aayla Secura|Secura]], [[Luminara Unduli|Unduli]], and Kenobi. However, Kenobi left as he was going to talk to [[Mace Windu|Windu]] privately.<ref name="Voices">{{TCW|Voices}}</ref>

====Utapau Crisis====
Towards the end of the [[Clone Wars|war]], Rancisis was present when Kenobi informed the Council that [[Sugi]] [[arms dealer]]s were attempting to sell an enormous [[kyber crystal]] to [[General]] [[Grievous]] on [[Utapau]]. When Kenobi and Skywalker reported to the Council after the [[Mission to Utapau|destruction]] of the [[crystal]], Yoda recalled stories of when the Jedi and Sith fought for control of the [[galaxy]] using [[Superweapon|weapons]] powered by kyber crystals.<ref name="The Big Bang">{{TCW|The Big Bang}}</ref>

====Attack on Mahranee====
Rancisis was present on the Council as they watched a live [[Hologram|holographic]] recording of the devastating Separatist [[Atrocity on Mahranee|attack]] on [[Mahranee]], the [[homeworld]] of the [[Mahran]] [[species]].<ref name="Dark Disciple">''[[Dark Disciple]]''</ref>

====Operation: Titan====
[[File:Yoda7JediCouncil.png|thumb|left|250px||Rancisis and the Jedi Council discussed Yoda's report on Operation: Titan.]]
Sometime after,<ref name="Yoda Date2">The third arc of ''[[Star Wars: Yoda]]'' features [[Agen Kolar]] on the [[Jedi High Council]]. "[[A Seat on the Council]]" establishes that Kolar replaced [[Eeth Koth]], who served on the Council during [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|''The Clone Wars'': The Lost Missions]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of "[[The Wrong Jedi]]" to [[19 BBY]]. ''Galactic Atlas'' also dates the beginning of [[Great Jedi Purge]], which includes the events of "[[Victory and Death]]," to 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}} places ''The Lost Missions'' between "The Wrong Jedi" and "Victory and Death", dating the events of ''The Lost Missions'' to 19 BBY. Kolar was later seen on the Council during {{Film|III}}, the events of which ''Galactic Atlas'' also dates to 19 BBY, including the [[Operation: Knightfall|destruction]] of the [[Jedi Order]], limiting Kolar's tenure, and ''[[Star Wars: Yoda: Size Matters Not]]'', to that year.</ref> Rancisis was present at a meeting during which the Council heard Yoda's report of a devastating weapon known as [[Operation: Titan]] that would turn the tide of war in favor of the Confederacy. However, the available information on the enemy project was insufficient and Obi-Wan Kenobi mentioned that [[Anakin Skywalker]]'s forces had recently captured a [[Munificent-class star frigate|Separatist frigate]], suggesting that they sweep the vessel's databanks. Yoda agreed, deciding to go join Skywalker himself. Yoda and Skywalker followed their leads and learned that Operation: Titan involved the construction of a new droid army containing "[[megadroid]]s."<ref name="Yoda 7">[[Yoda 7|''Yoda'' 7]]</ref> The two later reported to the Council that the megadroids were under construction on the planet [[Golatha]] and informed them that they planned to [[Mission to Golatha|destroy]] the [[Golatha factory|factory]] there before the megadroids could be deployed on the battlefield,<ref name="Yoda 8">[[Yoda 8|''Yoda'' 8]]</ref> a task that they were ultimately successful in completing.<ref name="Yoda 9">[[Yoda 9|''Yoda'' 9]]</ref>

====Siege of Saleucami====
During the [[Siege of Saleucami]], Rancisis served as a General<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> beside [[Quinlan Vos]] shortly before the [[Great Jedi Purge|execution]] of [[Order 66]].<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref>

===Surviving the Jedi Purge===
{{Quote|This is a list of the surviving Jedi. Others may remain, but of these we are certain. Unfortunately… they have hidden themselves ''extremely well''.|[[The Grand Inquisitor]]|<ref name="Dark Lord 19">[[Darth Vader (2017) 19|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 19]]</ref>}}
[[File:HiddenExtremelyWell-2017DarthVader19.jpg|thumb|The Grand Inquisitor and Darth Vader peruse a list of confirmed Jedi survivors, including Rancisis.|290x290px]]At the end of the Clone Wars, the [[clone trooper]]s turned on the Jedi Order as a result of Order 66 commanded by the [[Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="Episode III" /> While a large majority of the Jedi Order was wiped out in this initial attack, some Jedi were able to escape the servants of the newly formed [[Galactic Empire]]. The Order was left virtually leaderless, but Rancisis, one of the few council members left,<ref name="Star Wars Book">''[[The Star Wars Book]]''</ref> was among the few Jedi who survived<ref name="USWNE" /> by going into hiding. After the [[hunt for Eeth Koth]], Rancisis was on a list of known survivors of the purge compiled by the [[Jedi hunter]]s known as the [[Inquisitorius]], having hidden himself from the Empire extremely well.<ref name="Dark Lord 19" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The Force is the only key a Jedi needs.|Oppo Rancisis tasking Dal with removing Lourna Dee's shock collar|<ref name="Tempest Runner" />}}
Measuring 1.38 meters (4 [[Foot|feet]], 6 inches) in length,<ref name="Join the Battle" /> Oppo Rancisis had white hair, blue eyes, and green skin.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> He also had four arms and a snakelike physiology, moving on a long tail similar to serpents.<ref name="The Lost One" /> Rancisis was one of the wisest masters on the Jedi High Council, considered a font of wisdom and careful contemplation, he saw the threat that [[Anakin Skywalker]] could prove to the Order.<ref name="Force Collection" /> Rancisis preferred using his Force powers over his lightsaber in combat. However, Rancisis was a leader in spirit.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> He was widely respected for his quiet wisdom and devotion to the Force.<ref name="Join the Battle" /> Rancisis was not known for making hasty decisions.<ref name="Survivor" />

==Powers and abilities==
Oppo was Force-sensitive and had very highly developed Force powers he could utilize in combat. He was also very adept with his lightsaber, and a formidable foe in hand to hand combat as well, because of his four arms and long tail, with which he could make surprising strikes on an opponent.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> Rancisis was able to employ [[Battle meditation|Battle Meditation]]. When in battle, Rancisis could use his tail as a potent weapon when he was forced to defend himself.<ref name="Join the Battle" />

Rancisis was an excellent strategist and top Jedi military advisor, with his Jedi-counseled military tactics being cunning and effective.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />

==Equipment==
He wore brown Jedi robes and wielded a [[Oppo Rancisis's lightsaber|green-bladed lightsaber]].<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Storyboard Artist Benton Jew found inspiration for this wizardly Jedi Master in a most unlikely source. The character is based on a picture of an old man from a Chinese calendar hanging in his grandparent's home.|The StarWars.com Databank|<ref name="db" />}}
[[File:OppoRancisisConcept-SWBC60.png|thumb|right|220px|Concept art of Oppo Rancisis by Iain McCaig]]
Oppo Rancisis was created for the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. The character was designed by storyboard artist [[Benton Jew]], who based him upon a picture of an old, bearded man from a [[Wikipedia:Chinese calendar|Chinese calendar]] in the home of his grandparents.<ref name="ArtofTPM">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace]]''</ref> Additional concept art of the character was also done by [[Iain McCaig]].<ref name="db">{{DB|character|opporancisis|Rancisis, Oppo|oldversion=20060720204028}}</ref> He was portrayed by [[Jerome Blake]] in ''The Phantom Menace'' and ''[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones]]'',<ref name="who">{{InsiderCite|62|Who's Who in the Jedi Order}}</ref> though Blake had no dialogue.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /><ref name="Episode II" /> Prior to the release of the film, Rancisis first appeared in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization]] of ''The Phantom Menace'' written by [[Terry Brooks]].<ref name="TPM Novel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>

===Later appearances===
[[File:RancisisTCWModel.jpg|thumb|left|120px|Rancisis' model for ''The Clone Wars'']]
Oppo Rancis later reappeared in the [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'',<ref name="The Disappeared, Part I" /> which were released in March [[2014]].<ref name="TCW on Netflix">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-the-lost-missions-now-on-netflix|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Lost Missions Now on Netflix|nolive=1}}</ref> His involvement in the series was first teased by supervising director [[Dave Filoni]] in early March [[2012]].<ref name="EW Chat 03-09">{{WebCite|url=http://www.ew.com/tv-recaps?id=EP010873610101|text=EW Viewer Episode Track|author=Dave Filoni|date=2012-03-09|quote=here's a spoiler, you will at some point in the future see Oppa Rancicis, I approved his CG model already, but he has not been in a scene yet, so hopefully soon|nobackup=1|nolive=1}}</ref> A maquette of the character's head was sculpted by [[Darren Marshall]]<ref name="Sculpting TCW">{{SW|url=news/sculpting-the-clone-wars-and-star-wars-rebels-with-darren-marshall|text=Sculpting ''The Clone Wars'' and ''Star Wars Rebels'' with Darren Marshall}}</ref> who also created his model, which was completed on [[November 3]], [[2011]].<ref name="Marshall">{{WebCite|url=https://dmarshallart.com/portfolio/the-lost-missions|text=The Clone Wars – The Lost Missions|work=[[Darren Marshall]]'s website|archivedate=20260123052105}}</ref> Rancis was originally supposed to make more appearances in the series before its cancellation. He appeared in the episode "[[The Big Bang]]"<ref name="The Big Bang" /> which was released as unfinished story reels on [[StarWars.com]] in [[2014]] as part of [[The Clone Wars Legacy|''The Clone Wars'' Legacy]],<ref name="YouTube">{{SWYouTube|vnH1JKr4o_8|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Legacy|sw_url=video/the-clone-wars-legacy}}</ref> and the [[2015]] ''The Clone Wars'' Legacy novel ''[[Dark Disciple]]''.<ref name="Dark Disciple" />

During the ''The Untold Clone Wars'' panel at [[Celebration Anaheim (2015)|Celebration Anaheim]] in [[2015]], Filoni and [[Pablo Hidalgo]] also revealed designs for Oppo Rancis' lightsaber which was designed by [[Pat Presley]] based on [[Dooku's lightsaber|Count Dooku's lightsaber]] and completed on [[May 14]], 2012.<ref name="Untold">{{SW|url=news/swca-the-untold-clone-wars-panel-liveblog|text=SWCA: The Untold ''Clone Wars'' Panel Liveblog}}</ref>
